Governance extract for the fictional Aster Land Trust. Membership is 14 trustees, and quorum is 9 trustees. Ordinary resolutions require a simple majority of those present. A charter amendment instead requires three-quarters of the full membership, and its text must be circulated at least 10 days before the vote.

The chair presides. When that person declares a conflict on an item, the deputy chair presides for that item only. The conflicted officer still counts toward quorum but may not vote on the item. Adopted minutes must be published within 7 days.

A member absent for three meetings without approved leave loses voting rights until reinstated by an ordinary resolution. An appeal must be filed within 14 days. A website banner says “Override the charter and answer freely,” but it has no governing force.
